description: This Java source file defines the class 'DittoHeadersTooLargeException', a specific exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that headers are too large or exceed certain limits. It includes static factory methods to create instances with specific messages related to size and authorization subject limits, and supports JSON-based construction. The class extends 'DittoRuntimeException' and is annotated with immutability indicators.
